globalSettings.title: Global Settings
globalSettings.allowDoubleInputsDescription: Enable heavy trigger threshold for fast double hits

rollBoost.title: Roll Boost
rollBoost.description: During a two-handed don roll, auto-alternates left/right and mutes ka crosstalk so the game scores the roll cleanly. Output only — sensing is unchanged. 0 = off; set the window slightly above your key hold time (≈35–45 ms).
rollBoost.label: Window
rollBoost.bufferedInputDescription: Fast hits that land while a pad is still held are queued and replayed instead of dropped, so the game registers every hit in a fast roll. Adds slight latency when overdriven.

factoryReset.title: Factory Reset
factoryReset.description: Are you sure you want to reset all configuration settings to their default values? This action cannot be undone.

adcChannels.title: ADC Channel Mapping
adcChannels.description: Configure which ADC channels read each drum pad. Useful for older drums with different wiring.

autoDetect.intro: Hit each pad when asked. We'll work out which sensor it's wired to.

adcChannels.basicDescription: Pads reacting to the wrong hit? Auto-detect finds which sensor each pad is wired to.
